senses.gloss: Kshaṇa = Sūrya (the Sun): III, 150.--Do.,^2 pl. (ºāḥ) = Śiva (1000 names^2).
Kshaṇabhojin, a prince. § 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 7, †207 (? among the remnants of Duryodhana's army).
Kshapā = Sūrya (the Sun): III, 150.--Do.,^2 pl. (ºāḥ) = Śiva (1000 names^2).
Kshapācara, pl. (“night-walkers”) = Rākshasa, pl.: III, 16506.--Do. sg.: III, 16497 (= Rāvaṇa); V, 7539 (= Sthūṇa).

Kshatradeva, son of Śikhaṇḍin. § 561 (Yānasandhip.): V, 57, 2263 (has joined the Pāṇḍavas).--§ 572 (Rathātirathasaṅkhyānap.): V, 171, 5902 (among the rathas of the army of the Pāṇḍavas).--§ 573 (Ambopākhyānap.): V, 196, 7646.--§ 585 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 93, 4152 (followed Bhīmasena); 95, 4254, (), 4271, 4309 (Bhagadatta pierced his right arm).--§ 589 (Droṇābhishekap.): VII, 10, 358.--§ 590 (do.): VII, 14, 543 (fought with Lakshmaṇa). --§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 21, 904 (fought with Droṇa), 910; 23, 955 (Śaikhaṇḍiḥ, description of his horses), 974 (Śikhaṇḍinaḥ putraṃ, description of his horses).--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 6, 176 (Śikhaṇḍitanayaḥ, has been slain by Lakshmaṇa). Cf. Śaikhaṇḍi, Śikhaṇḍitanaya.

Kshatradharman, son of Dhṛshṭadyumna. § 572 (Rathātirathasaṅkhyānap.): V, 171, 5899 (Dhṛshṭadyumnasya tanayaḥ, is a half ratha).--§ 585 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 93, 4152.--§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 21, 903 (attacked Droṇa); 23, 954 (śoṇāśvaḥ).--§ 593 (Abhimanyuvadhap.): VII, 35, 1509 (proceeded against Droṇa).--§ 598 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 85, 3049 (Saumakiḥ).--§ 599 (do.): VII, 125, 5079, 5082 (is slain by Droṇa).--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 6, 175 (had been slain by Droṇa). Cf. Dhṛshṭadyumnasuta, Kshatravarman, Saumaki.
Kshatrahan, a Pāṇḍava warrior. § 573 (Ambopākhyānap.): V, 196, 7646 (ºhā Kshatradevaś ca, C.; but B. has Kshatradeva-Brahmadevau, in the rear of the army of the Pāṇḍavas).
Kshatrañjaya, a Pāṇḍava warrior. § 589 (Droṇābhishekap.): VII, 10, 358 (son of Dhṛshṭadyumna?, attacked Droṇa).

Kshatravarman = Kshatradharman(?). § 589 (Droṇābhishekap.): VII, 10, 358 (attacked Droṇa).--§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 25, 1073, 1074 (only B., C. has by error Kṛtavº), 1076 (fought with Jayadratha).
